disclaimer.s8Body: You are responsible for compliance with all laws and regulations applicable to your jurisdiction and trading activity.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.effectiveAndUpdated: Effective date: 22 March 2026 | Last Updated: 22 March 2026
privacy.s1Body: Auto-Trading ("Company", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable privacy laws.
privacy.s2Personal1: Account information (name, email, phone number, country)
privacy.s2Usage1: Browser type, IP address, and device information
privacy.s2Usage2: Pages visited and time spent on pages
privacy.s2Usage3: User interactions and feature usage patterns
privacy.s2Cookie2: Preference cookies to remember your settings
privacy.s2Cookie3: Analytics cookies via Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager
privacy.s2Cookie4: Marketing cookies to analyze campaign performance
privacy.s3Lead: We process your personal data based on:
privacy.s3Consent: You have explicitly consented to our data collection and use
privacy.s3Contract: Processing is necessary to provide our services to you
privacy.s3Legal: Processing is required by applicable laws and regulations
privacy.s3Legitimate: Processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests, such as improving service quality
privacy.s4Item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our trading platform
privacy.s4Item3: Store and sync your trading bots, strategies, and configurations
privacy.s4Item4: Analyze platform usage to enhance user experience
privacy.s4Item5: Send service updates and support communications
privacy.s4Item6: Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
privacy.s4Item7: Detect and prevent fraud or security issues
privacy.s5Item1: For tracking website usage and user behavior
privacy.s5Item2: For hosting, authentication, and real-time database services
privacy.s5Item3: Your API keys are used solely for trading execution
privacy.s5Body: We only share the minimum data necessary with these services and maintain data processor agreements in compliance with GDPR Article 28.
privacy.s6Lead: As an EU resident, you have the following rights:
privacy.s6Item1: Request a copy of your personal data
privacy.rightToErasure: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten):
privacy.s6Item4: Limit how we process your data
privacy.s6Item5: Receive your data in a portable format
privacy.s6Item6: Oppose our processing of your data
privacy.s6Item7: Withdraw consent without affecting prior processing
privacy.s6Body: To exercise these rights, contact us at support@auto-trading.app
privacy.s7Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, secure authentication, and regular security audits. However, no online transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s8Body: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes. You can request deletion at any time, except where legal obligations require retention.
privacy.s9Body: Exchange API keys are encrypted and used only to enable trading functionality. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your API keys and setting appropriate permission scopes. We recommend regular key rotation.
privacy.s10Body: When you first visit our website, you will see a consent banner asking for your permission to use cookies and analytics. You can manage your preferences at any time. If you decline analytics cookies, Google Tag Manager will not collect your data.
privacy.s11Body: Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside the EU. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for international transfers, including Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.s12Body: We may update this policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated to you via email, and the updated effective date will be reflected on this page. Your continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s13ComplaintsBody: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
